description: Four-panel evidence summary: differential diagnosis by polyp burden, HPO phenotype frequencies with Wilson CIs, the predicted-versus-reported penetrance gap, and the ClinVar interpretation burden
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import requests, time

# ---------------- Differential diagnosis matrix for adenomatous polyposis ----------------
dd = pd.DataFrame([
 # gene, inheritance, typical polyp count, onset decade, molecular signature, extracolonic hallmark
 ("MSH3",  "AR", "18-54",      5, "EMAST, MSS on 5-marker panel", "duodenal adenomas, breast ca (n small)"),
 ("APC",   "AD", ">100 (classic)", 2, "none (CIN)",               "desmoid, CHRPE, osteoma, hepatoblastoma"),
 ("APC (AFAP)","AD","10-99",   4, "none (CIN)",                   "duodenal adenomas, gastric fundic gland"),
 ("MUTYH", "AR", "10-100",     5, "C:G>A:T transversions, SBS18/36","duodenal adenomas, sebaceous tumours"),
 ("NTHL1", "AR", "8-50",       5, "C>T at CpC, SBS30",            "breast ca, multi-tumour spectrum"),
 ("MSH2/MLH1","AD","0-few",    4, "MSI-H, dMMR IHC loss",         "endometrial, urothelial, sebaceous"),
 ("POLE/POLD1","AD","10-100",  4, "ultramutation, POLE exo domain","brain, endometrial (POLD1)"),
 ("MBD4",  "AR", "10-50",      4, "CpG>TpG hypermutation, SBS1",  "uveal melanoma, AML"),
 ("AXIN2", "AD", "variable",   4, "none",                          "oligodontia, ectodermal dysplasia"),
 ("RNF43", "AD", "serrated",   5, "RNF43 LoF, Wnt hyperactivation","serrated polyposis"),
], columns=["gene","inh","polyps","onset_decade","signature","extracolonic"])

print(dd.to_string(index=False))

# ---------------- Figure: positioning of MSH3 polyposis among the differentials ----------------
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 9.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1, 1.05], hspace=0.38, wspace=0.26)

# Panel A: polyp burden vs inheritance
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
lo = [18,100,10,10,8,0,10,10,5,5]
hi = [54,1000,99,100,50,5,100,50,50,50]
ypos = np.arange(len(dd))[::-1]
cols = ["#C44E52" if g=="MSH3" else ("#4C72B0" if i=="AR" else "#8C8C8C") for g,i in zip(dd.gene, dd.inh)]
for y,l,h,c in zip(ypos, lo, hi, cols):
    ax.plot([l,h],[y,y], lw=7, color=c, solid_capstyle="round", alpha=0.85)
ax.set_yticks(ypos); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{g} ({i})" for g,i in zip(dd.gene, dd.inh)], fontsize=9)
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("cumulative adenoma count (log scale)")
ax.set_title("A. MSH3 polyposis sits in the attenuated range (18-54 adenomas),\noverlapping MUTYH, NTHL1 and attenuated APC", fontsize=10.5)
ax.axvspan(10, 99, color="#f0e68c", alpha=0.18)
ax.text(32, len(dd)-0.4, "attenuated range", ha="center", fontsize=8.5, color="#8a7500")

# Panel B: phenotype frequencies with Wilson CIs (15-patient census)
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint
pheno = pd.DataFrame([
 ("HP:0005227 adenomatous colonic polyposis",15,15),
 ("HP:0003003 colon cancer",4,15),
 ("HP:0004783 duodenal polyposis",4,15),
 ("HP:0001399 hepatic cysts",4,15),
 ("HP:0003002 breast carcinoma (women)",3,5),
 ("HP:0000107 renal cyst",2,15),
 ("HP:0033770 gastric adenocarcinoma",1,15),
 ("HP:0009592 astrocytoma",1,15),
 ("HP:0002671 basal cell carcinoma",1,15),
], columns=["hpo","k","n"])
pheno["p"]=pheno.k/pheno.n
ci=[proportion_confint(k,n,method="wilson") for k,n in zip(pheno.k,pheno.n)]
pheno["lo"]=[c[0] for c in ci]; pheno["hi"]=[c[1] for c in ci]
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
y=np.arange(len(pheno))[::-1]
ax.errorbar(pheno.p*100, y, xerr=[(pheno.p-pheno.lo)*100,(pheno.hi-pheno.p)*100],
            fmt="o", color="#4C72B0", ecolor="#aab7d0", capsize=3, markersize=7)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(pheno.hpo, fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("frequency among reported patients (%), Wilson 95% CI")
ax.set_xlim(-3,105)
for yy,k,n in zip(y, pheno.k, pheno.n): ax.text(102, yy, f"{k}/{n}", fontsize=8, va="center", ha="right", color="#555")
ax.set_title("B. Phenotype frequencies from the full 15-patient census.\nEvery interval is wide: n is the limiting factor", fontsize=10.5)

# Panel C: the penetrance gap
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
cats=["predicted biallelic\nindividuals worldwide\n(gnomAD v4, HWE)","published patients\n(6 families, 5 reports)"]
vals=[7000, 15]
b=ax.bar(cats, vals, color=["#8C8C8C","#C44E52"], width=0.55)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylabel("individuals (log scale)")
for r,v in zip(b, vals): ax.text(r.get_x()+r.get_width()/2, v*1.35, f"{v:,}", ha="center", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
ax.set_title("C. A ~470-fold gap between predicted and reported cases:\nincomplete penetrance, under-ascertainment, or both", fontsize=10.5)
ax.set_ylim(5, 40000)

# Panel D: ClinVar interpretation burden
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
labels=["uncertain\nsignificance","likely\nbenign","pathogenic +\nlikely path.","conflicting","benign"]
vals=[2996,1601,666,247,133]
cols=["#8C8C8C","#55A868","#C44E52","#DD8452","#55A868"]
w=ax.bar(labels, vals, color=cols)
for r,v in zip(w, vals): ax.text(r.get_x()+r.get_width()/2, v+60, f"{v:,}", ha="center", fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_ylabel("ClinVar germline records (n=5,665)")
ax.set_title("D. 52.9% of MSH3 variants are VUS. Of the 666 P/LP alleles,\n618 truncate the protein and 2 are missense", fontsize=10.5)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=8.5); ax.set_ylim(0,3400)

fig.suptitle("MSH3-related attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis (MONDO:0044300, OMIM:617100): evidence summary",
             fontsize=13.5, fontweight="bold", y=0.985)
plt.show()
